title: ReGIST DAO
tagline: A platform to license, verify and register your brand, technology, patent, copyright, trademark etc. and monetized it on the blockchain.
description:
𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁?

Nowadays registering or applying for a patenting, trademark, copyright etc. could be really difficult as you also need to pay for large sum of fees and also require a vast amount of effort exerted which could really lessen the motivation of  people with great ideas, inventions and technology.

But what if we can have decentralized platform for doing all of these things in the blockchain and by the use of the Polygon network they can mint their technology, infrastructure, trademark and patent with very low fees.

This could also be a sandbox platform for Web 3.0, blockchain developers and hackers.

𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝘄𝗲 𝗱𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀? 𝗔𝗻𝗱 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝗶𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝘄𝗮𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝗱𝗼𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀?

1.	First of all we can use the blockchain to register all of the brands, patents, trademarks and copyrights. Meaning very low fees.

2.	Second you don’t need to register of regional (country based) and international recognition as blockchain can provide both and we know that you cannot fake anything on the blockchain and you can also use blockchain to prevent duplicates.

3.	Third is bridging the gap between inventors and people with ideas by making it much more easier and cheap for them.

4.	Fourth it really encourages people to invent and build stuffs as they don’t need to worry of the hassle of hiring an maybe a lawyer or pay a large sum of money just so they can have their idea be registered and monetized for the industrial use.


𝗠𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗚𝗼𝗮𝗹:

Really the main goal of licensing your technology, brand, idea or technology is so it will be more legitimate and prevent unauthorized use of the technology created. The other purpose is really to monetized on something you have build and created. Essentially making people pay to use something that you have invented or created.
how_its_made:
TECH STACK: 



1. The smart contracts and the minting processes will be built on top of the Polygon network.



2. Moralis and Covalent will both be used on the backend and backend api.



3. Superfluid will be used for payment and monetization solutions for this project.



4. The graph and graphql for indexing the platform.
